title: Ranked dim-the-rest spotlight

members.role: the ranked field rises and HOLDS - read whole before any one bar is named (D40 holds ~5 s; the guide's floor ~1 s)
ONE bar keeps its ink while the rest dim to E67's dim (T37) - the bar the sentence names
its pill names what the rank means ('3rd largest buyer'), on the lit bar's printed value (P72 T18's part: value)
a second pill names a second bar of the field while the first stays lit

does: A ranked field rises and holds long enough to be read whole, then one bar keeps its ink while the rest dim and a pill says what its rank means - and a second pill names another bar of the field.

use_when.act: RANKS - one member of a ranking (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R30)
use_when.shape: series (a ranking): three or more bars on one scale, sorted
use_when.use: bars rise, hold ~1 s, ONE ignites while the rest dim, a leader pill, then a second pill (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN.md:215; D40 14:22-14:50, 'bought even more short-term bonds than Japan')
use_when.dont: skip the hold (the field must be read first); the whole ranking is the claim (no one bar to name); the rank is typed rather than read off the sorted field

source: P71 T24 (harvest v2 R30): D40 (u70oUWgVoYU) 14:18-14:54 read off the video on disk - rise 861-862 s, the field held to 868, the rest dim and bar 3 lit with '3rd Largest Buyer' at 869-870, a second pill at 875-877; proved as a private test-bed beat by projects/_proofs/p71-recipes/proof_t24.py (r30: ev-dram-contract-v1 sorted by value) - no approved cut carries it
